name: Willem de Groot

Specialized in Kubernetes orchestration, infrastructure as code with Terraform, and AWS cloud architecture. Passionate about reliability, automation, and building resilient systems that support rapid product growth.

Define infrastructure as code standards using Terraform across engineering teams
Establish SLOs and error budgets for critical customer-facing services
Mentor junior DevOps engineers and conduct architecture reviews
Drive incident response process improvements and post-mortem culture
Migrated on-premise workloads to AWS using containerized deployments
Built CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins and GitLab CI for microservices
Automated infrastructure provisioning with Terraform and Ansible
Implemented centralized logging and monitoring stack for production environments
Maintained Linux server infrastructure and network configurations
Assisted in deploying and monitoring internal applications
